run_joint_position_control: run the UR5 robot arm through a sequence of target joint positions with planning enabled
create_robot_ur5: create a pyrobot Robot instance for a UR5 arm with arm enabled and base, camera, gripper disabled
move_arm_to_home: move the UR5 robot arm back to its home position using the go_home method
set_joint_positions: set the UR5 arm joint positions to a target list of 7 joint angles with trajectory planning
review_main: review the main function that commands a UR5 robot arm through joint position control with target positions
